column1: # Production Rust files over the size limit at the point the limit was
# introduced, with the exact physical line count each one had at revision
# a136209fb16a177708ea4ddc995ba2cb3c70f5a8. A count tightens downward when the
# file shrinks but stays over the limit.
# This file is a ratchet, not an exemption list. `scripts/production-file-guard.py
# failing, and fails when any of them grows, when a file not listed here goes
# over the limit, or when a listed file comes back under it without its entry
# being removed. Decomposing one of these files means deleting its line in the
# same change. When the list is empty the `--baseline` flag has nothing left to
# forgive and the bare guard is the whole rule.
# Format: repository-relative path, one tab, physical line count.
